title: Signal: OS command execution via child_process.exec (javascript) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the child_process.exec call in javascript code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any child_process.exec call matches, including fully trusted invocations. Dataflow from untrusted input is not proven — treat every hit as review-required.
fpNotes: Trusted, hardcoded commands (no variables) are the common false positive; confirm no interpolated input before dismissing.
